mappingCoverage.scope: Native version entries are a cross-platform superset; all registry packages in the upstream librsvg Cargo.lock are preserved conservatively, including development and non-Linux target dependencies. This is not an exact production SBOM.

limitations: For crates without published VCS metadata, official version tags or an explicit matching workspace subpackage version associate upstream license files; this is not a byte-for-byte VCS identity assertion for the published crate. Original crate archive checksums and published declarations are retained.
Full native source/build/replacement references are supplied; exact binary reproducibility and legal-completeness attestation are not claimed.
